caption:
Letting her do it

Cella wanted to help with the lid and waited.

People learn a small task faster when they finish it themselves, even if it takes a little longer.

For the friend who lets you do it yourself.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a table and an open food container. A royal blue figure on the right looks down with narrowed eyes and trembles as a lid wobbles above the container. A small ink-black figure with white eyes starts to step over, stops, and holds still. The lid finally clicks on, and both figures turn happy with a pulse.
